name: Anirevo
blurb: Vancouver's largest and fastest-growing anime convention, with cosplay contests, concerts and Japanese voice-actor guests at the Vancouver Convention Centre.
notes: Anirevo Vancouver 2026 ran July 31-Aug 2, 2026, already before the research window. No 2027 Vancouver dates are announced on the official homepage (confirmed via extract.mjs home pass and one web search on 2026-10-05); the site still shows the 2026 key art. A separate 'Anirevo Toronto' event has since launched (per a homepage banner) but is a different city/entry, not this file.
